ensure_fitted_raise: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch module tree are fitted, raising ValueError if any are not
ensure_fitted_warn: ensure all ScaleFactor modules in a PyTorch module tree are fitted, logging a warning instead of raising
review_ensure_fitted: review the ensure_fitted function to understand how it validates ScaleFactor modules recursively
refactor_ensure_fitted: refactor ensure_fitted to support custom error messages or additional validation logic for ScaleFactor modules
test_ensure_fitted: test ensure_fitted with a module containing unfitted ScaleFactor children to verify ValueError is raised
